task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for ADP-09 at src/design/adp-09-tamper-evident-audit-chain.md. Define additive audit chaining semantics for new nullable columns chain_hash and prev_chain_hash on audit rows, including canonical content rules for hash input, per-tenant predecessor selection, insert-time chain computation behavior, and chain validation traversal/error reporting rules. Preserve existing OBS-03 fields/queries and define compatibility behavior for historical rows where chain fields are null. Include migration/index guidance, operational implications, and explicit testability mapping for the tampering scenario in ADP-09 acceptance criteria. Design only; no implementation edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design specifies deterministic canonicalization and SHA-256 chain computation rules for chain_hash
Per-tenant predecessor linkage and first-row boundary behavior are explicit and non-ambiguous
Validation algorithm and failure semantics for tampered rows are concrete and testable
Compatibility plan preserves existing OBS-03 behavior and legacy rows during additive rollout
Design includes traceability to ADP-09 acceptance criteria with actionable test guidance

result.summary: Design artefact for ADP-09 tamper-evident audit chaining with deterministic canonicalization, per-tenant predecessor semantics, validation traversal/failure reporting, additive compatibility behavior, migration-index guidance, and acceptance-to-test traceability.
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2a) for ADP-09 implementation, then TEST-DESIGNER for tamper scenario coverage.
